observed.caption: Two large dark funnel-shaped metal structures stand on a paved plaza in an urban park with additional similar structures, benches, trees, a pond, and high-rise buildings in the background under an overcast sky.
observed.description: The photo shows an outdoor urban park with four large dark brown funnel-shaped metal structures with rectangular cut-out openings, two prominent in the foreground on a light-colored paved plaza and two smaller in the midground. Green grass, small trees and shrubs surround the plaza, with several dark benches placed on the pavement and a small figure sitting on the central bench. A small pond is visible on the right side near trees, and a curved paved pathway is in the foreground. In the background, tall modern high-rise buildings with glass facades rise above the tree line under a cloudy overcast sky, and small colorful canopies with indistinct figures are visible in the distant left and center.
